jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for Magic Mail mobile puzzle world map. Right: six warm rounded timber logs lashed together, ivory cut ends and subtle gold rope. Strict orthographic TOP DOWN, bridge long axis perfectly vertical in all cells. No rails.
